hebrewText: הַ/צּוּר֙ תָּמִ֣ים פָּעֳל֔/וֹ כִּ֥י כָל דְּרָכָ֖י/ו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אֵ֤ל אֱמוּנָה֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין עָ֔וֶל צַדִּ֥יק וְ/יָשָׁ֖ר הֽוּא

tokens.bdb: properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally, a rock or boulder; figuratively, a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous)
tokens.kjv: edge, [idiom] (mighty) God (one), rock, [idiom] sharp, stone, [idiom] strength, [idiom] strong. See also H1049 (בֵּית צוּר).

tokens.bdb: entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth
tokens.kjv: without blemish, complete, full, perfect, sincerely (-ity), sound, without spot, undefiled, upright(-ly), whole.
act, deed, do, getting, maker, work.

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
tokens.kjv: along, away, because of, [phrase] by, conversation, custom, (east-) ward, journey, manner, passenger, through, toward, (high-) (path-) way(-side), whither(-soever).
tokens.explanation: derek — caminho, estrada, modo de vida, conduta

tokens.bdb: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
tokens.kjv: [phrase] adversary, ceremony, charge, [idiom] crime, custom, desert, determination, discretion, disposing, due, fashion, form, to be judged, judgment, just(-ice, -ly), (manner of) law(-ful), manner, measure, (due) order, ordinance, right, sentence, usest, [idiom] worthy, [phrase] wrong.

tokens.bdb: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
tokens.kjv: God (god), [idiom] goodly, [idiom] great, idol, might(-y one), power, strong. Compare names in '-el.'

tokens.bdb: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.kjv: faith(-ful, -ly, -ness, (man)), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.enLiteralWord: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.explanation: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.explanationEn: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanationEn: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.kjv: convenient, equity, Jasher, just, meet(-est), [phrase] pleased well right(-eous), straight, (most) upright(-ly, -ness).

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
